themeDescription: What is AI? What am I? What makes humans special?

days.title: I'm an AI - Understanding Your Digital Learning Partner
days.learning_objective: Develop foundational AI literacy by understanding what artificial intelligence is and isn't, building the critical awareness necessary for responsible AI use in learning and life.

days.title: What Makes You Human - The Gifts No AI Has
days.learning_objective: Recognize the unique human capabilities—consciousness, emotion, embodiment—that remain irreplaceable in an AI-enhanced world, building confidence in human value.

days.title: Types of Intelligence - Many Ways to Be Smart
days.learning_objective: Explore multiple intelligences and understand that AI represents one form of intelligence while humans possess diverse forms including emotional, kinesthetic, and creative intelligence.

days.title: How AI Learns - Patterns in the Data
days.learning_objective: Understand the basic mechanism of machine learning—pattern recognition in large datasets—demystifying AI and enabling critical evaluation of AI outputs.

days.title: How Humans Learn - Experience and Connection
days.learning_objective: Contrast human learning through experience, emotion, and relationship with AI's pattern-matching, appreciating the depth and meaning of human knowledge.

days.title: The AI Around You - Already Part of Daily Life
days.learning_objective: Recognize AI in everyday applications—recommendations, voice assistants, filters—building awareness of AI's pervasive presence and enabling informed choices.

days.title: Human + AI - The Power of Collaboration
days.learning_objective: Understand that the best outcomes emerge from human-AI collaboration, with each contributing unique strengths, preparing for a future of augmented intelligence.

days.title: What AI Can Do - Speed, Scale, and Pattern Recognition
days.learning_objective: Identify AI's genuine strengths—processing vast data, recognizing patterns, working tirelessly—understanding where AI adds value in learning and work.

days.title: What AI Can't Do - The Limits of Artificial Intelligence
days.learning_objective: Understand AI's fundamental limitations—lack of consciousness, true understanding, common sense, and embodied experience—maintaining realistic expectations.

days.title: Your Unique Gifts - Capabilities No AI Has
days.learning_objective: Identify personal strengths and human capabilities that remain uniquely valuable, building confidence and purpose in an AI-enhanced world.

days.title: Mistakes AI Makes - Confidently Wrong
days.learning_objective: Learn about AI hallucinations, biases, and errors, developing the healthy skepticism essential for responsible AI use and critical thinking.

days.title: Mistakes Humans Make - Our Biases Too
days.learning_objective: Recognize human cognitive biases and error patterns, understanding that critical thinking must apply to all sources—including ourselves.

days.title: The Training Process - How AI Learns From Data
days.learning_objective: Understand that AI reflects its training data, including biases and gaps, enabling critical evaluation of AI outputs and their origins.

days.title: Your Training Process - Learning From Chosen Experiences
days.learning_objective: Recognize that humans curate their own learning through choices, relationships, and attention, taking agency over personal development.

days.title: AI Memory vs Human Memory - Different Systems, Different Purposes
days.learning_objective: Compare AI's perfect recall with human memory's selective, meaning-making nature, understanding the value of each approach.

days.title: Why AI Sounds Smart - Language Patterns vs True Understanding
days.learning_objective: Distinguish between AI's fluent language production and genuine understanding, developing discernment about apparent intelligence.

days.title: What Understanding Means - Beyond Pattern Matching
days.learning_objective: Explore what it means to truly understand something—context, application, feeling—versus merely predicting the next word.

days.title: The Limits of Text - What Words Cannot Capture
days.learning_objective: Recognize that AI trained on text misses embodied knowledge, tacit understanding, and direct experience that define human knowing.

days.title: Experience vs Information - Why Doing Beats Reading
days.learning_objective: Understand the irreplaceable value of direct experience in learning, motivating hands-on engagement beyond AI-mediated information.

days.title: Building Your Foundation - The Knowledge That Supports All Learning
days.learning_objective: Identify foundational knowledge and skills that enable lifelong learning, investing in capabilities that compound over time.

days.title: Learning to Learn - Meta-Cognition as Superpower
days.learning_objective: Develop meta-cognitive awareness—thinking about thinking—the skill that makes all other learning more effective.

days.title: Your Learning Style - Myth vs Reality
days.learning_objective: Understand that fixed learning styles are a myth, embracing flexible, multi-modal learning strategies for different contexts.

days.title: The Growth Mindset - Intelligence Can Be Developed
days.learning_objective: Embrace the growth mindset—the belief that abilities develop through effort—as foundation for lifelong learning.

days.title: Curiosity as Fuel - The Drive That Powers All Learning
days.learning_objective: Cultivate curiosity as the essential motivation for learning, the engine that drives sustained engagement and discovery.

days.title: Questions Over Answers - The Value of Inquiry
days.learning_objective: Shift from seeking quick answers to asking better questions, developing inquiry as a core learning practice.

days.title: The Humble Learner - Knowing What You Don't Know
days.learning_objective: Develop intellectual humility—accurate assessment of knowledge gaps—as foundation for genuine learning.

days.title: Learning Communities - We Learn Better Together
days.learning_objective: Recognize the social nature of learning and the value of learning communities for motivation, perspective, and growth.

days.title: Teachers in Your Life - Who Guides Your Learning?
days.learning_objective: Identify the formal and informal teachers in your life, appreciating the human relationships that shape learning.

days.title: You as Teacher - Teaching Deepens Understanding
days.learning_objective: Experience teaching as a learning method, understanding that explaining to others deepens your own knowledge.

days.title: Month in Review - Foundations Established
days.learning_objective: Synthesize and consolidate the month's learning about AI foundations, human capabilities, and learning principles.

days.title: Setting Intentions - What Will You Learn This Year?
days.learning_objective: Set meaningful learning intentions for the year ahead, taking ownership of your educational journey.
